title: Help tooltips are no longer reachable by keyboard after HelpTooltip removal
reason: factually wrong: removed HelpTooltip trigger span had no tabIndex and no isInteractive, so focusability is unchanged

title: Entrypoint requires PLUGIN_VERSION to match the globbed jar name
reason: pre-existing ENV javaagent paths already required PLUGIN_VERSION to match; entrypoint only fails earlier

title: Entrypoint silently disables other plugin jars and can leave .tmp files
reason: by design: disabling other plugin jars is the tested upgrade behavior; .jar.tmp is not loaded and is overwritten

title: Dockerfile checks are fixed-string greps
reason: coverage gap with no concrete escaping defect; image build and start covered by integration-test.yml

title: Sensor tests rewritten from SensorContextTester to mocks
reason: by design: SensorContextTester/TestInputFileBuilder absent from SonarQube 26.9 libs; new verifications are stricter

title: Alias override spread assumes resolve.alias is an array
reason: false positive: resolve.alias in the webapp Vite config is an object, so the object spread is correct

title: queryKeys stub does not match webapp entitlement query keys
reason: by design: verbatim copy of the upstream #1298 stub

title: ENTRYPOINT override resets inherited CMD so SonarQube never starts
reason: false positive: base image has Cmd null and its entrypoint.sh substitutes DEFAULT_CMD when called with no arguments

title: No build-time check that PLUGIN_VERSION matches the copied jar name
reason: not introduced by the diff: the existing -javaagent ENV paths already required the match; release.Dockerfile fails the build on an empty value
